title: Separate human outbound clicks from automated ones
why: The 2026-09-26 KPI run shows 32 outbound clicks from 32 distinct visitors, all from /housing-search, while that page drew at most 2 pageviews (it is absent from a top-10 list whose last entry has 2). /go logs server-side without JavaScript and filters bots by user agent only (lib/affiliate-clicks.ts). The routine has been reading this as growing demand.
definition_of_done: Each outbound click records whether the same visitor has a page view in the prior 30 minutes, and kpi-report prints clicks with and without a matching page view.
verify: kpi-report prints an outbound line split into clicks with and without a prior page view.
